title: Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Handling for Failed Child Order Submissions
precondition: Sub-account #42 order fails due to momentary socket timeout.
steps: 1. Route failed child order to DLQ.
expected_result: DLQ consumer initiates exponential retry (3 attempts); recovers fill status without manual intervention.
actual_result: Failed child order submissions route to DLQ with exponential retry (3 attempts) to prevent orphan dropped allocations.
